map.不能，它只反映代码规模。删除冗余代码会减少行数却提升质量，用不同语言或风格实现同: No, they only reflect code size. Deleting redundant code reduces the line count while improving quality, and the same feature implemented in different languages or styles can vary severalfold in length. A sensible use is to watch trends and composition (comment ratio, file length) rather than judging output by line count.

map.按所选语言（选择自动时按 JavaScript 处理）取该语言的行注释规则与块注: Take the line-comment and block-comment rules of the selected language (auto is treated as JavaScript) and scan line by line: a line that is empty after trimming counts as blank; while inside a block comment the line counts as a comment line, and if the block end marker appears on the same line the block state ends (content after the marker is re-evaluated); otherwise first check whether the line starts with a line-comment marker, then whether a block comment starts — entering block state when the start marker is hit and no end marker follows on the same line. Lines that are neither comments nor inside a block count as code. Total lines = all lines; code ratio = code lines ÷ total lines × 100% (0 when total is 0), 1 decimal.
